summary.en: The period is mostly routine: cooperation with Vietnam and Armenia, a social-protection initiative, and a community donation, with the GDELT tone mildly positive. The main negative item is a foreign-reported death of a Japanese billionaire's son, a single crime rather than a national crisis, so the score sits slightly above an ordinary day.

Social protection plan for workers facing climate risks

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: a large drug seizure is being investigated with regional cooperation, customs and Mekong patrol cooperation is growing, and chili exports are up. A street shooting in Laos and reports that Laos may obstruct an ASEAN maritime code add some negative weight, and GDELT tone is slightly above the world average.

GDELT tone is clearly more positive than the world average, though there are no domestic headlines and a few foreign items on military presence and drug trafficking.

Health working group prepares for LDC graduation ahead of 2027
Tuas Power explores increased hydropower imports from Laos

Constructive items include a tax treaty with Hong Kong, a proposal to export 500MW of renewable power to Singapore, and health planning ahead of LDC graduation, with no crisis reported.

en: Proposal to export 500MW renewable electricity to Singapore
Tax agreement with Hong Kong expanding treaty network

summary.en: Coverage is thin and mostly routine: a regional Buddhist forum in Vientiane and a renewables push are mildly positive, while a Chinese investment-fraud case tied to Laos is a minor negative. GDELT tone is negative but is only a secondary signal, so the period looks close to ordinary.
summary.ja: 報道量は少なく、大半は日常的な内容です。ビエンチャンで開催された地域仏教フォーラムと再生可能エネルギーの推進は、やや前向きな内容です。一方、ラオスに関連する中国人による投資詐欺事件は、軽微なマイナス要因です。GDELTのトーンはネガティブですが、副次的な指標にすぎないため、この期間は概ね平常に近いと見られます。
summary.ko: 보도량이 적고 대부분 일상적인 내용입니다. 비엔티안에서 열린 지역 불교 포럼과 재생에너지 추진은 다소 긍정적인 소식이며, 라오스와 관련된 중국인 투자 사기 사건은 경미한 부정적 요인입니다. GDELT 어조는 부정적이지만 부차적인 지표일 뿐이므로, 이 기간은 대체로 평상시에 가까운 것으로 보입니다.
summary.hi: कवरेज सीमित है और अधिकतर सामान्य है: वियनतियान में आयोजित एक क्षेत्रीय बौद्ध मंच और नवीकरणीय ऊर्जा पर ज़ोर हल्के सकारात्मक हैं, जबकि लाओस से जुड़ा एक चीनी निवेश-धोखाधड़ी मामला एक मामूली नकारात्मक पहलू है। GDELT का लहजा नकारात्मक है, लेकिन वह केवल एक गौण संकेतक है, इसलिए यह अवधि सामान्य के करीब लगती है।
summary.el: Η κάλυψη είναι περιορισμένη και κυρίως συνηθισμένη: ένα περιφερειακό βουδιστικό φόρουμ στο Βιεντιάνη και η ώθηση για ανανεώσιμες πηγές ενέργειας έχουν ήπια θετικό πρόσημο, ενώ μια υπόθεση κινεζικής απάτης επενδύσεων που συνδέεται με το Λάος αποτελεί μικρής κλίμακας αρνητικό στοιχείο. Ο τόνος του GDELT είναι αρνητικός, αλλά αποτελεί δευτερεύον δείκτη, οπότε η περίοδος φαίνεται κοντά στο κανονικό.
summary.tr: Haber kapsamı sınırlı ve çoğunlukla rutin nitelikte: Vientiane'de düzenlenen bölgesel bir Budist forumu ile yenilenebilir enerji hamlesi hafif olumlu, Laos bağlantılı bir Çin yatırım dolandırıcılığı davası ise küçük bir olumsuz gelişme. GDELT tonu olumsuz, ancak yalnızca ikincil bir gösterge; bu nedenle dönem olağan görünüme yakın.
summary.es: La cobertura es escasa y en su mayoría rutinaria: un foro budista regional en Vientián y un impulso a las energías renovables son levemente positivos, mientras que un caso chino de fraude de inversión vinculado a Laos es un pequeño factor negativo. El tono de GDELT es negativo, pero es solo una señal secundaria, por lo que el periodo parece cercano a lo ordinario.
summary.fr: La couverture est maigre et surtout routinière : un forum bouddhiste régional à Vientiane et une initiative en faveur des énergies renouvelables sont légèrement positifs, tandis qu'une affaire chinoise de fraude à l'investissement liée au Laos constitue un léger facteur négatif. Le ton de GDELT est négatif, mais il ne s'agit que d'un signal secondaire ; la période paraît donc proche de la normale.
summary.de: Die Berichterstattung ist dünn und größtenteils routinemäßig: Ein regionales buddhistisches Forum in Vientiane und ein Vorstoß im Bereich erneuerbare Energien wirken leicht positiv, während ein chinesischer Anlagebetrugsfall mit Bezug zu Laos einen geringen negativen Faktor darstellt. Der GDELT-Ton ist negativ, doch handelt es sich nur um ein sekundäres Signal; der Zeitraum wirkt daher nahezu gewöhnlich.
summary.pt: A cobertura é escassa e, em sua maioria, rotineira: um fórum budista regional em Vientiane e um impulso em energias renováveis têm leve tom positivo, enquanto um caso chinês de fraude de investimento ligado ao Laos é um pequeno fator negativo. O tom do GDELT é negativo, mas é apenas um sinal secundário, de modo que o período parece próximo do normal.
summary.it: La copertura è scarsa e per lo più di routine: un forum buddhista regionale a Vientiane e una spinta sulle energie rinnovabili hanno un tono leggermente positivo, mentre un caso di frode sugli investimenti cinese legato al Laos è un lieve elemento negativo. Il tono GDELT è negativo ma è solo un segnale secondario, quindi il periodo appare vicino alla normalità.
summary.ru: Освещение скудное и в основном рутинное: региональный буддийский форум во Вьентьяне и продвижение возобновляемой энергетики имеют слабо позитивную окраску, а китайское дело о мошенничестве с инвестициями, связанное с Лаосом, — незначительный негативный фактор. Тон GDELT негативный, но это лишь второстепенный сигнал, поэтому период выглядит близким к обычному.
summary.ar: التغطية محدودة وروتينية في معظمها: منتدى بوذي إقليمي في فيينتيان ودفع نحو الطاقة المتجددة يحملان نبرة إيجابية طفيفة، بينما تمثل قضية الاحتيال الاستثماري الصينية المرتبطة بلاوس عاملاً سلبياً طفيفاً. نبرة GDELT سلبية لكنها إشارة ثانوية فقط، لذا تبدو الفترة قريبة من المعتاد.
summary.fa: پوشش خبری اندک و عمدتاً روتین است: یک نشست بودایی منطقه‌ای در وینتیان و تلاش برای انرژی‌های تجدیدپذیر لحن اندکی مثبت دارند، در حالی که پرونده کلاهبرداری سرمایه‌گذاری چینی مرتبط با لائوس یک عامل منفی جزئی است. لحن GDELT منفی است اما تنها سیگنالی ثانویه است، بنابراین دوره نزدیک به حالت عادی به نظر می‌رسد.
summary.zh: 报道较少且大多属于常规内容：万象举办的一场区域佛教论坛和可再生能源推进工作带来轻微正面影响，而与老挝有关的一起中国投资诈骗案则是轻微负面因素。GDELT语气为负面，但只是次要信号，因此该时段看起来接近正常水平。

summary.en: Curfews were imposed in Paris and other cities following widespread urban violence and unrest on October 17. Prime Minister Lecornu says the curfews helped the night pass calmly, but the government is under pressure. An orange alert is in force in 7 departments in the southeast due to flooding, the CAC 40 fell more than 3% on a monthly basis, and news coverage is very negative.

en: Violent incidents on October 17 and curfews in many cities
Flooding in the southeast and orange alert in 7 departments
Government under pressure, international echo of the events and Trump's harsh statements
Monthly decline of 3.29% in the CAC 40
Calm night after the curfews and reduced tension (mitigating)

summary.en: Violent protests over the weekend of 17 October have led to a large police and troop deployment, possible curfews and a military aircraft crash, which points to serious domestic strain. Partial offsets include the Code Noir repeal, solid Bureau Veritas and Atos results, and a broadly flat CAC 40.

en: Violent protests and riots; troops and police deployed, curfews considered
Military aircraft crash between Nancy and Pont-à-Mousson under search

Tourism cancellations and foreign travel advisories amid the riots

Government tightening protest curbs and deploying military
Expected Moody's downgrade over debt and political crisis

Partial offsets include Moody's holding France's rating at Aa3 and storm damage that is still mostly restorable, but the CAC 40 is down 4.19% over the month.

Fatal racist shooting near Paris; Macron calls it terrorism
Moody's keeps France's sovereign rating at Aa3

Deadly Yvelines shooting described by Macron as a racist terrorist attack
Government under pressure for political responses to protesters' demands

Around 1,000 arrests and police deployment of 70,000 officers
Mass shooting ('Tuerie') in Yvelines and racist attack in Trappes

Authorities warn of 'very high' violence risk, deploying 70,000 personnel
Dockers strike against government budget

summary.en: France faces nationwide youth-led protests ('acte III') with 70,000 police deployed and warnings of violence, plus a negative outlook from Fitch on its credit rating. Markets were flat and much of the local news is routine, so the score sits in the serious-concern band but short of a crisis.

en: Nationwide protests with 70,000 police mobilised for Halloween weekend
Fitch turns credit outlook negative while Moody's stays stable
Government vows tough response to renewed unrest

summary.en: France faced a third weekend of large youth-led protests, with 320,000 participants and some violence on Halloween, met by a 70,000-strong police deployment. Fitch revised its outlook to negative, and GDELT tone is notably more negative than the world average, though the CAC 40 was flat and some foreign coverage called the unrest overstated.
summary.ja: フランスでは、若者主導の大規模な抗議デモが3週連続で続き、約32万人が参加し、ハロウィーンには一部で暴力事件も発生した。これに対し、7万人規模の警察が動員された。フィッチは同国の格付け見通しを「ネガティブ」に引き下げた。GDELTのトーンは世界平均よりも明らかに否定的であったが、CAC 40は横ばいで推移した。一部の海外報道では、騒乱が誇張されているとの見方も示された。
summary.ko: 프랑스에서는 청년 주도의 대규모 시위가 3주 연속 이어졌으며, 약 32만 명이 참가했고 핼러윈에는 일부 폭력 사태가 발생했다. 이에 맞서 7만 명 규모의 경찰이 배치되었다. 피치는 프랑스의 신용등급 전망을 부정적으로 하향 조정했다. GDELT 어조는 세계 평균보다 뚜렷하게 부정적이었으나, CAC 40 지수는 보합세를 보였다. 일부 해외 언론은 이번 소요 사태가 과장되었다고 보도했다.
summary.hi: फ्रांस में युवाओं के नेतृत्व में बड़े पैमाने पर विरोध प्रदर्शनों का तीसरा सप्ताहांत रहा, जिसमें लगभग 3,20,000 लोगों ने भाग लिया और हैलोवीन पर कुछ हिंसा हुई। इसके जवाब में 70,000 की मजबूत पुलिस तैनाती की गई। फिच ने फ्रांस के रेटिंग आउटलुक को नकारात्मक कर दिया। GDELT का लहजा विश्व औसत से उल्लेखनीय रूप से अधिक नकारात्मक है, हालाँकि CAC 40 स्थिर रहा, और कुछ विदेशी मीडिया कवरेज ने अशांति को बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर बताए जाने की बात कही।
summary.el: Η Γαλλία αντιμετώπισε το τρίτο διαδοχικό Σαββατοκύριακο μεγάλων διαδηλώσεων με πρωταγωνιστές τους νέους, με 320.000 συμμετέχοντες και κάποια βία την ημέρα του Halloween, στις οποίες αντιστάθηκε μια αστυνομική επιχείρηση 70.000 αξιωματικών. Η Fitch αναθεώρησε τις προοπτικές της σε αρνητικές, και ο τόνος του GDELT είναι αισθητά πιο αρνητικός από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο, ωστόσο ο δείκτης CAC 40 παρέμεινε σταθερός, ενώ ορισμένα ξένα μέσα ενημέρωσης χαρακτήρισαν τις αναταραχές υπερβολικές.
summary.tr: Fransa, Cadılar Bayramı'nda bazı şiddet olaylarının yaşandığı, 320.000 katılımcının yer aldığı ve 70.000 polis memurunun görevlendirildiği üçüncü hafta sonu üst üste gençlerin öncülük ettiği büyük protestolarla karşı karşıya kaldı. Fitch, ülkenin kredi notu görünümünü negatife revize etti; GDELT ton ölçümü dünya ortalamasına göre belirgin biçimde daha olumsuz, ancak CAC 40 yatay seyretti ve bazı yabancı haber kaynakları karışıklıkların abartıldığını belirtti.
summary.es: Francia afrontó su tercer fin de semana de grandes protestas encabezadas por jóvenes, con 320.000 participantes y algunos episodios violentos en Halloween, a los que respondió con un despliegue policial de 70.000 agentes. Fitch revisó su perspectiva a negativa, y el tono de GDELT es notablemente más negativo que la media mundial, aunque el CAC 40 se mantuvo estable y algunas cadenas extranjeras calificaron los disturbios de exagerados.
summary.fr: La France a connu un troisième week-end de grandes manifestations menées par la jeunesse, avec 320 000 participants et quelques violences à l'occasion d'Halloween, face à un dispositif policier de 70 000 hommes. Fitch a révisé à la baisse sa perspective, passant à négative, et le ton de GDELT est nettement plus négatif que la moyenne mondiale, bien que le CAC 40 soit resté stable et que certains médias étrangers aient jugé les troubles exagérés.
summary.de: Frankreich erlebte ein drittes Wochenende mit großen, von Jugendlichen angeführten Protesten mit 320.000 Teilnehmenden und vereinzelten Gewaltausbrüchen an Halloween; die Polizei setzte 70.000 Beamte ein. Fitch hat den Ausblick für das Land auf negativ gesenkt, und der GDELT-Tonwert ist deutlich negativer als der Weltdurchschnitt, während der CAC 40 unverändert blieb und einige ausländische Medien die Unruhen als übertrieben bezeichneten.
summary.pt: A França enfrentou o terceiro fim de semana consecutivo de grandes protestos liderados por jovens, com 320.000 participantes e alguns episódios de violência no Halloween, que foram enfrentados com um dispositivo policial de 70.000 agentes. A Fitch revisou a perspectiva para negativa, e o tom do GDELT é notavelmente mais negativo do que a média mundial, embora o CAC 40 tenha permanecido estável e alguns veículos estrangeiros tenham considerado os distúrbios exagerados.
summary.it: La Francia ha affrontato il terzo fine settimana consecutivo di ampie proteste guidate dai giovani, con 320.000 partecipanti e alcuni episodi di violenza ad Halloween, a cui la polizia ha risposto con un dispiegamento di 70.000 agenti. Fitch ha rivisto al negativo l'outlook sul Paese, e il tono di GDELT è decisamente più negativo della media mondiale, sebbene il CAC 40 sia rimasto invariato e alcuni media stranieri abbiano definito i disordini esagerati.
summary.ru: Франция столкнулась с третьими выходными подряд крупных протестов, возглавляемых молодёжью: 320 000 участников, в Хэллоуин отмечались отдельные случаи насилия; ответом стала полиция численностью 70 000 человек. Fitch пересмотрело прогноз по рейтингу Франции на негативный, а тон GDELT заметно более негативен, чем в среднем по миру, хотя индекс CAC 40 остался без изменений, а некоторые зарубежные издания назвали беспорядки преувеличенными.
summary.ar: واجهت فرنسا عطلة نهاية أسبوع ثالثة من الاحتجاجات الكبيرة التي يقودها الشباب، بمشاركة 320,000 شخص، وشهدت أعمال عنف في عيد الهالوين، فيما واجهتها الشرطة بانتشار قوامه 70,000 عنصر. وعدّلت وكالة فيتش نظرتها المستقبلية لتصنيف فرنسا إلى سلبية، ونغمة GDELT أكثر سلبية بوضوح من المتوسط العالمي، رغم أن مؤشر CAC 40 بقي مستقراً، وعدّت بعض التغطيات الأجنبية الاضطرابات مبالغاً فيها.
summary.fa: فرانسه سومین آخر هفته اعتراضات گسترده به رهبری جوانان را تجربه کرد، با 320,000 شرکت‌کننده و برخی خشونت‌ها در روز هالووین، که با استقرار 70,000 نیروی پلیس پاسخ داده شد. فیچ چشم‌انداز رتبه‌بندی فرانسه را به منفی تغییر داد، و لحن GDELT به‌طور قابل توجهی منفی‌تر از میانگین جهانی است، هرچند شاخص CAC 40 بدون تغییر ماند و برخی پوشش‌های خارجی ناآرامی‌ها را اغراق‌آمیز توصیف کردند.
summary.zh: 法国迎来第三个周末大规模青年主导的抗议活动，参与人数约32万，万圣节当天出现暴力事件，警方部署了7万名警力应对。惠誉将法国评级展望下调至负面；GDELT语调明显比全球平均水平更为负面，但CAC 40指数持平，部分外国媒体认为此次骚乱被夸大了。

summary.es: El periodo consiste en su mayoría en noticias rutinarias, con un hecho positivo destacable: Estados Unidos flexibilizó las sanciones a la aviación para que Belavia pueda comprar piezas y aviones de Boeing. Una operación humanitaria exitosa en Aleshki y la reapertura de una yeshivá suman al lado positivo. Los informes de organizaciones de derechos humanos sobre al menos 22 presos políticos recluidos en hospitales psiquiátricos compensan en parte esto, y el tono de GDELT es más negativo que el promedio mundial.
summary.fr: La période est en grande partie composée d'actualités courantes, avec un point positif notable : les États-Unis ont assoupli les sanctions aériennes, permettant à Belavia d'acheter des pièces et des avions Boeing. Une opération humanitaire réussie à Aleshki et la réouverture d'une yeshiva renforcent le bilan positif. Les signalements d'organisations de défense des droits selon lesquels au moins 22 prisonniers politiques sont détenus dans des hôpitaux psychiatriques compensent en partie ce constat, et le ton de GDELT est plus négatif que la moyenne mondiale.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum besteht überwiegend aus Routinemeldungen; ein bemerkenswert positiver Punkt ist die Lockerung US-amerikanischer Luftfahrtsanktionen, sodass Belavia Boeing-Ersatzteile und -Flugzeuge kaufen kann. Eine erfolgreiche humanitäre Operation in Aleshki und die Wiedereröffnung einer Jeschiwa stützen die positive Seite. Berichte von Menschenrechtsgruppen über mindestens 22 politische Gefangene in psychiatrischen Kliniken wiegen dies teilweise auf, und der GDELT-Tonwert ist negativer als der weltweite Durchschnitt.
summary.pt: O período é, em sua maioria, de notícias rotineiras, com um ponto positivo notável: os EUA suavizaram as sanções à aviação, permitindo que a Belavia compre peças e aeronaves da Boeing. Uma operação humanitária bem-sucedida em Aleshki e a reabertura de uma yeshiva reforçam o lado positivo. Relatos de grupos de direitos humanos sobre pelo menos 22 presos políticos internados em hospitais psiquiátricos compensam parte disso, e o tom do GDELT é mais negativo que a média mundial.
summary.ja: この期間は大部分が日常的なニュースで、注目すべき好材料として、米国がベラビアによるボーイング社製部品や航空機の購入を認めるため航空分野の制裁を緩和したことが挙げられます。アレシキでの人道支援活動の成功や、再開されたイェシーバー(ユダヤ教の宗教学校)も好材料に加わります。一方、人権団体が少なくとも22名の政治犯が精神科病院に収容されていると報告しており、これが好材料の一部を相殺しています。GDELTのトーンは世界平均よりも否定的です。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 일상적인 뉴스이며, 주목할 만한 긍정적 요인으로는 미국이 벨라비아가 보잉 부품과 항공기를 구매할 수 있도록 항공 관련 제재를 완화한 조치가 있습니다. 알레시키에서 성공적으로 진행된 인도적 지원 작전과 재개된 예시바(유대교 신학교)도 긍정적 측면을 더합니다. 반면 인권 단체들이 최소 22명의 정치범이 정신병원에 수용되어 있다고 보고하면서 이러한 긍정적 요인의 일부가 상쇄되며, GDELT 어조는 세계 평균보다 부정적입니다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि ज़्यादातर नियमित समाचारों की है, जिसमें एक उल्लेखनीय सकारात्मक घटनाक्रम है: अमेरिका ने विमानन प्रतिबंधों में ढील दी है, जिससे बेलावियां बोइंग के पुर्जे और विमान खरीद सकेगी। अलेशकी में सफल मानवीय अभियान और फिर से खोला गया येशिवा (यहूदी धार्मिक विद्यालय) भी सकारात्मक पक्ष में जुड़ते हैं। वहीं मानवाधिकार समूहों की रिपोर्ट कि कम से कम 22 राजनीतिक कैदी मनोरोग अस्पतालों में रखे गए हैं, इसका कुछ हिस्सा संतुलित करती है, और GDELT का स्वर वैश्विक औसत से अधिक नकारात्मक है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος αποτελείται κυρίως από συνηθισμένες ειδήσεις, με ένα σημαντικό θετικό στοιχείο: οι ΗΠΑ χαλάρωσαν τις κυρώσεις στην αεροπορία, ώστε η Belavia να μπορεί να αγοράζει ανταλλακτικά και αεροσκάφη της Boeing. Θετικά συμβάλλουν επίσης μια επιτυχημένη ανθρωπιστική επιχείρηση στο Αλέσκι και η επαναλειτουργία μιας γιεσίβα (εβραϊκής θρησκευτικής σχολής). Αυτό εξισορροπείται εν μέρει από αναφορές ανθρωπιστικών οργανώσεων ότι τουλάχιστον 22 πολιτικοί κρατούμενοι κρατούνται σε ψυχιατρικά νοσοκομεία, ενώ ο τόνος του GDELT είναι πιο αρνητικός από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο.

summary.en: In Lebanon, Israeli strikes in the south, accusations against the Lebanese army over Hezbollah's weapons, and domestic tension in Beirut (Fanar tunnel) continue. Positive signs include Qatar's proposal for a power plant and gas agreement, Arab League and international diplomatic support, and increased army patrols. However, the fragile post-war situation, concern over a security gap after the end of UNIFIL, and economic difficulties keep the score low.

en: Israeli strikes in the south and accusations that the Lebanese army is responsible for Hezbollah's weapons
Domestic tension in Beirut around the Fanar tunnel and security measures against armed appearances
Diplomatic and energy investment support from the Arab League and Qatar
Concern over a security gap after UNIFIL and the need for reconstruction
Poverty and economic fragility, with warnings of economic risk linked to the Gulf

summary.en: The period is dominated by Israeli strikes in south Lebanon, escalating Hezbollah disarmament disputes, US-mediated military talks, and the looming end of the UNIFIL mission with job losses. Some positive economic and diplomatic items, such as a Qatari power and LNG plan and Saudi trade talks, do not offset the serious security pressure.

en: Israeli strikes in south Lebanon and escalating Hezbollah disarmament disputes
UNIFIL mandate ending, with hundreds of jobs lost in the south
US-mediated Israel-Lebanon military talks amid rising tensions

summary.en: Lebanon's day was dominated by Israeli strikes in the south despite a nominal ceasefire, threats against Beirut's southern suburbs, and a domestic standoff over a seized Hezbollah explosives shipment. Diplomatic activity (Florida military talks, a planned French army support conference) and routine governance news partly offset this, and GDELT tone is markedly more negative than the world average.

en: Israeli strikes in south Lebanon despite ceasefire
Hezbollah explosives case and judicial warrants raise domestic tension
Florida Lebanon-Israel talks and planned French army conference

summary.en: Israeli airstrikes, shelling and ground advances in the south continue despite a nominal ceasefire, and Lebanon-Israel talks in Florida/Tampa have made no breakthrough, raising fears of renewed war. Domestic institutions are still functioning, with cabinet debate on the Hezbollah explosives case and calls for dialogue, which keeps the score above the crisis band.

en: Israeli strikes and ground incursions in southern Lebanon despite ceasefire
Lebanon-Israel talks show no breakthrough; fears of renewed war
Cabinet dispute over referring Hezbollah explosives shipment to judiciary

summary.en: Israeli strikes, drone activity and a reported 700 sq km 'security belt' in the south, plus UN peacekeepers preparing to leave, point to serious security strain. Domestic political tensions over seized Hezbollah explosives and a rift in the government add pressure, partly offset by IMF engagement, a Qatari electricity financing proposal and transport planning.

en: Israeli strikes and drone flights over southern Lebanon and Beirut
Reported Israeli-held 'security belt' and UN peacekeeper withdrawal
Political standoff over seized Hezbollah explosives and government rifts

summary.en: Israeli strikes continued in southern Lebanon despite a ceasefire, with reports of a 700 sq km occupation zone and new US travel warnings about escalation. Some positives, such as Qatar's aid lighting and Tripoli joining an economic corridor, and a framework agreement stalled by disputes, do not offset the security strain.

en: Israeli strikes in south continue despite ceasefire
700 sq km Israeli 'security belt' occupation reported
US embassy renews travel warnings citing regional escalation

summary.en: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon continued despite a ceasefire, with troops massed at the border and UN peacekeepers preparing to leave, while the framework agreement stalled amid domestic political tension. Some positives appeared (Qatari economic cooperation, a youth football win, routine services), but the security escalation dominates.

en: Israeli strikes in south Lebanon despite ceasefire
Israeli troops massed along the border
UN peacekeepers preparing to exit Lebanon

summary.en: The period is dominated by renewed war fears: reports say Hezbollah is preparing for a new regional war with Iranian funding, and Israel is striking southern Lebanon in ceasefire violations. Modest positives, such as joining the IMEC ports expansion and carbon-market re-entry, do not offset the security risk and the sharply negative news tone.

en: Reports of Hezbollah rearming and preparing for new regional war
Israeli strikes and incursions in southern Lebanon despite ceasefire
Lebanon joins IMEC ports club, expanding Beirut and Tripoli ports

summary.en: Lebanon's day was dominated by continued Israeli strikes and demolitions in the south, a stalled ceasefire framework, and fears of renewed Hezbollah-Israel fighting ahead of the UNIFIL drawdown. Diplomacy on a European replacement force and a successful ship rescue offset some of the strain, and no mass violence or institutional collapse was reported.

en: Israeli strikes and demolitions in south Lebanon continue
Ceasefire framework stalled; Aoun warns of security vacuum after UNIFIL
Olive harvest hampered by access limits and drone activity

summary.en: Israeli artillery fire, demolitions and strikes in south Lebanon continue despite a ceasefire and framework arrangement, and disarmament of Hezbollah remains deadlocked. Economic and institutional news is routine, with some reform and export initiatives, so the overall picture is serious but short of full war.

en: Continued Israeli artillery and strikes in south Lebanon despite ceasefire
Hezbollah rejects disarmament and the US-brokered framework
UNIFIL withdrawal raises questions about future protection

summary.en: Lebanon faces heavy pressure: Israeli attacks and troops in the south, fears of renewed war with Hezbollah, a stalled negotiation track, and a cabinet boycott over an explosives case. Some positives, such as reported reform progress and continued European support, do not offset the security and political strain.

en: Fears of renewed war and Hezbollah preparations for battle
Aoun reports no progress in talks; Israeli attacks continue
Cabinet ministers boycott over Hezbollah explosives case

summary.en: Israeli strikes, demolitions and home burnings in southern Lebanon continue, and exports fell 16.5%. Partly offsetting this, state institutions advanced a military-court case on Hezbollah explosives and launched a process on Palestinian camp weapons.

en: Israeli bombing and home demolitions in southern Lebanon
Military court charges 13 over seized explosives truck
Lebanon exports down 16.5%

summary.en: Israeli airstrikes, house demolitions and new military roads in the south, plus fears of a 'third war', dominate the period and show serious pressure on Lebanese sovereignty and civilians. Partial positives, such as state charges over Hezbollah explosives, a hospital funded by Kuwait and pharmaceutical sector progress, do not offset them.
summary.ja: 南部におけるイスラエルの空爆、家屋の解体、新たな軍用道路建設、そして「第三次戦争」への懸念が今期を特徴づけており、レバノンの主権と市民に対する深刻な圧力を示している。ヒズボラの爆発物をめぐる国家による告発、クウェートが資金を提供した病院、医薬品分野の進展といった部分的な前向きな動きは、これらを相殺するには至っていない。
summary.ko: 이번 기간에는 남부 지역에 대한 이스라엘의 공습, 가옥 철거, 새로운 군용 도로 건설과 '제3차 전쟁'에 대한 우려가 두드러졌으며, 이는 레바논의 주권과 민간인에 대한 심각한 압박을 보여준다. 헤즈볼라 폭발물과 관련한 국가의 기소, 쿠웨이트가 자금을 지원한 병원, 제약 부문의 진전 등 일부 긍정적 사안이 있으나 이를 상쇄하지는 못한다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में दक्षिणी क्षेत्र में इज़रायली हवाई हमले, घरों का ध्वस्तीकरण और नई सैन्य सड़कों का निर्माण, तथा 'तीसरे युद्ध' की आशंकाएँ छाई रहीं, जो लेबनान की संप्रभुता और नागरिकों पर गंभीर दबाव को दर्शाता है। हिज़्बुल्लाह विस्फोटकों से जुड़े राज्य के आरोप, कुवैत द्वारा वित्तपोषित एक अस्पताल और फार्मास्यूटिकल क्षेत्र में प्रगति जैसे आंशिक सकारात्मक पहलू इनकी भरपाई नहीं करते।
summary.el: Οι ισραηλινοί αεροπορικοί βομβαρδισμοί, οι κατεδαφίσεις σπιτιών και οι νέοι στρατιωτικοί δρόμοι στον νότο, μαζί με τους φόβους για έναν «τρίτο πόλεμο», κυριαρχούν στην περίοδο και δείχνουν σοβαρή πίεση στην κυριαρχία του Λιβάνου και στους πολίτες του. Μερικές θετικές εξελίξεις, όπως οι κρατικές κατηγορίες για εκρηκτικά της Χεζμπολάχ, ένα νοσοκομείο που χρηματοδοτήθηκε από το Κουβέιτ και η πρόοδος στον φαρμακευτικό τομέα, δεν αντισταθμίζουν αυτά τα στοιχεία.
summary.tr: Güney Lübnan'da İsrail hava saldırıları, ev yıkımları ve yeni askeri yollar, ayrıca 'üçüncü savaş' korkusu bu dönemi belirliyor ve Lübnan egemenliği ile siviller üzerinde ciddi baskıyı gösteriyor. Hizbullah patlayıcıları nedeniyle devletin açtığı davalar, Kuveyt'in finanse ettiği bir hastane ve ilaç sektöründeki ilerleme gibi kısmi olumlu gelişmeler bu tabloyu dengelemeye yetmiyor.
summary.es: Los ataques aéreos israelíes, las demoliciones de viviendas y las nuevas carreteras militares en el sur, junto con los temores a una "tercera guerra", dominan el periodo y muestran una presión seria sobre la soberanía libanesa y los civiles. Los avances parciales, como los cargos del Estado por explosivos de Hezbolá, un hospital financiado por Kuwait y el progreso del sector farmacéutico, no compensan estos hechos.
summary.fr: Les frappes aériennes israéliennes, les démolitions de maisons et les nouvelles routes militaires dans le sud, ainsi que les craintes d'une « troisième guerre », dominent la période et traduisent une forte pression sur la souveraineté libanaise et sur les civils. Des progrès partiels, comme les poursuites engagées par l'État concernant des explosifs du Hezbollah, un hôpital financé par le Koweït et les avancées du secteur pharmaceutique, ne compensent pas ces éléments.
summary.de: Israelische Luftangriffe, Hausabrisse und neue Militärstraßen im Süden sowie Befürchtungen eines „dritten Krieges“ prägen den Zeitraum und zeigen erheblichen Druck auf die libanesische Souveränität und die Zivilbevölkerung. Teilweise positive Entwicklungen, etwa staatliche Anklagen wegen Sprengstoffen der Hisbollah, ein von Kuwait finanziertes Krankenhaus und Fortschritte im Pharmasektor, wiegen dies nicht auf.
summary.pt: Ataques aéreos israelenses, demolições de casas e novas estradas militares no sul, além de temores de uma "terceira guerra", dominam o período e mostram forte pressão sobre a soberania libanesa e sobre os civis. Avanços parciais, como as acusações do Estado sobre explosivos do Hezbollah, um hospital financiado pelo Kuwait e o progresso do setor farmacêutico, não compensam esses fatores.
summary.it: Attacchi aerei israeliani, demolizioni di abitazioni e nuove strade militari nel sud, oltre ai timori di una 'terza guerra', dominano il periodo e mostrano una grave pressione sulla sovranità libanese e sui civili. Alcuni sviluppi positivi parziali, come le accuse statali sugli esplosivi di Hezbollah, un ospedale finanziato dal Kuwait e i progressi del settore farmaceutico, non li compensano.
summary.ru: Израильские авиаудары, снос домов и строительство новых военных дорог на юге, а также опасения по поводу «третьей войны» определяют ситуацию в этот период и свидетельствуют о серьёзном давлении на суверенитет Ливана и на гражданское население. Частичные позитивные моменты, такие как обвинения государства в связи со взрывчаткой «Хезболлы», больница, финансируемая Кувейтом, и прогресс фармацевтического сектора, их не компенсируют.
summary.ar: تهيمن على الفترة الغارات الجوية الإسرائيلية وعمليات هدم المنازل وإنشاء طرق عسكرية جديدة في الجنوب، إضافة إلى المخاوف من «حرب ثالثة»، مما يُظهر ضغطاً خطيراً على السيادة اللبنانية وعلى المدنيين. ولا تُعوّض عنها الإيجابيات الجزئية، مثل الاتهامات الرسمية المتعلقة بمتفجرات حزب الله، ومستشفى تموله الكويت، والتقدم في قطاع الأدوية.
summary.fa: حملات هوایی اسرائیل، تخریب خانه‌ها و ساخت جاده‌های نظامی جدید در جنوب، همراه با نگرانی از «جنگ سوم»، این دوره را رقم می‌زند و نشان‌دهنده فشار جدی بر حاکمیت لبنان و غیرنظامیان است. نکات مثبت جزئی، از جمله اتهامات دولت درباره مواد منفجره حزب‌الله، بیمارستانی با حمایت کویت و پیشرفت بخش داروسازی، این وضعیت را جبران نمی‌کند.
summary.zh: 以色列在南部的空袭、房屋拆除和新修军用道路，以及对“第三次战争”的担忧，主导了这一时期，显示出对黎巴嫩主权和平民的严重压力。国家针对真主党爆炸物提出的指控、科威特资助的一家医院以及制药行业的进展等部分积极因素，并不能抵消这些负面情况。

58 kasaba sakinlerinin geri dönüşünün engellendiği bildiriliyor
Ülke genelinde 'üçüncü savaş' korkusu yaygın

Se informa que a los residentes de 58 localidades se les impide regresar
Temor generalizado en el país a una "tercera guerra"
fr: Les frappes aériennes et les démolitions israéliennes se poursuivent dans le sud du Liban
Les habitants de 58 villes seraient empêchés de revenir
Crainte largement répandue d'une « troisième guerre »
de: Israelische Luftangriffe und Abrisse im Süden des Libanon halten an
Bewohnern von 58 Orten soll die Rückkehr untersagt sein
Verbreitete Angst vor einem „dritten Krieg“ im Land
pt: Continuam os ataques aéreos e as demolições israelenses no sul do Líbano
Relata-se que moradores de 58 localidades estão impedidos de retornar
Medo generalizado no país de uma "terceira guerra"
it: Continuano gli attacchi aerei e le demolizioni israeliane nel Libano meridionale
Secondo quanto riferito, agli abitanti di 58 città viene impedito di tornare
Diffusa paura nel paese di una 'terza guerra'

По сообщениям, жителям 58 населённых пунктов запрещено возвращаться
Широко распространённый в стране страх перед «третьей войной»

تفيد التقارير بمنع سكان 58 بلدة من العودة
خوف واسع النطاق داخل البلاد من «حرب ثالثة»

گزارش‌ها حاکی از آن است که ساکنان ۵۸ شهرک از بازگشت منع شده‌اند
نگرانی گسترده در داخل کشور از «جنگ سوم»
zh: 以色列对黎巴嫩南部的空袭和拆除行动仍在继续
据报道，58个城镇的居民被禁止返回
国内普遍担心爆发“第三次战争”

summary.en: Panama is experiencing the effects of the strong earthquake of 9 October: about 11,460 people were affected, more than 8,000 children need humanitarian assistance, ground collapse and tsunami-related displacement in Isla Cañas, a road blocked by a landslide, and damaged schools and health facilities are reported. Aftershocks are decreasing, and reconstruction, the gradual reopening of schools and international aid are ongoing, which signals recovery. For a large-scale disaster period, the upper part of the 'serious problems' band is appropriate, because state institutions are functioning and economic indicators (financial inclusion, services trade) are positive.

en: Humanitarian impact after the earthquake: 11,460 affected, more than 8,000 children in need of assistance
Infrastructure damage: El Valle de Antón road closed for one month, damaged schools and polyclinics
Recovery efforts: housing reconstruction, gradual reopening of schools, decreasing aftershocks, international support
Pressure of drought on the canal and supply chain
Positive economic news: third place in financial inclusion, record services trade

summary.en: A magnitude 5.4 earthquake damaged homes, schools and institutions in Herrera, Coclé and Veraguas, and recovery is underway with schools reopening and aid arriving. Record Canal traffic offsets the damage, but the drought and rising femicide figures weigh on the score.

en: Earthquake damage in Herrera, Coclé and Veraguas, with reconstruction under way
Record annual Panama Canal traffic reported by foreign media
Water shortage and drought constraining the Canal's operations

summary.en: Panama is recovering from a recent earthquake, with housing inspections, rebuilding of the first 31 homes, and relief efforts under way, while the Canal posted record FY2026 revenue of $6.6 billion and record cargo. Tone is more negative than the global average, and the earthquake, dengue deaths and El Niño alerts weigh on the score, but the response appears to be functioning.

en: Earthquake damage: 47 critical road points and 23 bridges need repair
Canal de Panamá record revenue of $6.6 billion, up 16.6%
Reconstruction started; 9,391 homes under evaluation

summary.en: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake on the Azuero peninsula caused two deaths, damage in Penonomé and school closures affecting over 3,000 students, and reports say over 37,000 people were affected. This is offset by strong economic news: Canal of Panama revenue up 16%, WEF investment promotion, and a cabinet budget move.

en: Magnitude 7.7 earthquake; 37,000+ affected, two deaths
Penonomé cancels November celebrations after quake damage
Canal revenue up 16%; traffic and tonnage rising

summary.en: Panama is in the aftermath of a major magnitude 7.5 earthquake in the Azuero region, with damaged churches, shelters and reconstruction measures under way. Foreign aid, tax relief and positive economic items (canal traffic, coffee) partly offset the disaster and ongoing gang killings.

en: Major earthquake aftermath in Azuero with reconstruction and shelter needs
Foreign medical and financial aid, including Costa Rican mission and donations
Canal traffic and tonnage rose in fiscal 2026

summary.en: Panama is recovering from a recent earthquake, with international relief, a US$310M credit line for small firms, and ECLAC raising its 2026 growth forecast to 4.5%. Damage to schools and churches and water contamination weigh against these positives, so the day sits modestly above an ordinary period.

en: ECLAC raises Panama 2026 growth forecast to 4.5%
US$310M credit opens for small firms after quake
Foreign and UAE relief aid launched for earthquake victims

summary.en: Panama is recovering from a strong earthquake in the Azuero region, with reconstruction, school-year plans and mass meals for displaced people underway, plus a landslide at a former gold mine. Routine positives such as the World of Coffee event, Cobre Panamá hiring and sports results offset part of the disaster coverage, and press-freedom complaints add some strain.

en: Earthquake in Azuero causing displacement and reconstruction needs
Education ministry three-phase plan to save the school year
Landslide at quake-hit former gold mine threatening water sources

summary.en: A significant earthquake has damaged infrastructure and affected over 37,000 people, with over 1,000 aftershocks and temporary electoral sites set up. Offsetting this, the Line 3 Metro tunnel boring milestone, an approved port environmental impact study, and aid from companies show functioning institutions, and GDELT tone is milder than the world average.

en: Earthquake damage with over 37,000 people affected
Metro Line 3 tunnel excavation completed under the Canal
Corporate aid and temporary electoral sites after quake damage

summary.en: Panama's news over the period is mostly routine, with positive economic items such as Maersk's port commitment, the Puerto Barú environmental approval and improving Canal watershed conditions. Ongoing seismic activity, a new magnitude 5.6 tremor with evacuations and over 1,000 aftershocks, weighs against these gains.

en: Repeated magnitude 5.6 tremors and over 1,000 aftershocks weeks after the earthquake
Maersk commits to operating Panamanian ports permanently
Canal watershed improves and last-minute reservations restored

summary.en: Panama is in earthquake recovery, with the government funding 2,700 replacement homes and shelters being activated, alongside routine positive economic and diplomatic news such as Cobre Panamá hiring, canal advisory meetings and foreign ministerial visits. Negatives include an embezzlement arrest, scaled-back marina rebuilding and a new tremor, but overall the tone is better than the world average.

en: Government plans 2,700 homes and loans for earthquake reconstruction
Cobre Panamá surpasses 2,500 hires
Canal advisory board and strategic project meetings with Mulino

summary.en: Panama's news over the period is mostly routine, with positive diplomatic and economic items: German aid after the Azuero earthquake, support for leaving the EU tax list, and expanded Cobre Panamá hiring. Offsetting concerns include aftershocks, a 32-homicide rise in three provinces, and rising environmental crime.

en: German humanitarian aid sent after Azuero earthquake
Germany backs Panama's exit from EU tax list
Cobre Panamá hiring rises above 2,600 workers

summary.en: A magnitude 7.7 earthquake killed at least three people and forced demolition of historic buildings in Penonomé, and a Panamanian-flagged ship was attacked and set on fire off Oman. Offsetting this, the canal strategy, the US$35.1B budget advancing and diplomatic overtures such as offering to host US-Cuba talks show ordinary governance continuing.

en: Magnitude 7.7 earthquake; three deaths confirmed
Penonomé buildings made uninhabitable and slated for demolition
Panamanian-flagged vessel attacked and set on fire off Oman

summary.en: A series of strong earthquakes (reported up to magnitude 7.5 in one headline) hit Panama, with at least three deaths, power outages in Cañas, hospital evacuation protocols and damage assessments underway. Routine economic news, such as export growth and Canal transit increases, partly offsets the disaster, but the period is dominated by a major natural disaster.
summary.tr: Panama'yı, bir manşette 7.5 büyüklüğüne kadar bildirilen bir dizi güçlü deprem vurdu; en az üç kişi hayatını kaybetti. Cañas'ta elektrik kesintileri yaşanıyor, hastane tahliye protokolleri uygulanıyor ve hasar tespit çalışmaları sürüyor. İhracat artışı ve Kanal geçiş sayısındaki artış gibi rutin ekonomik haberler felaketin etkisini kısmen dengeliyor, ancak dönem büyük bir doğal afetin gölgesinde geçiyor.
summary.es: Una serie de fuertes terremotos (reportados hasta magnitud 7.5 en un titular) sacudió Panamá, con al menos tres muertos, cortes de electricidad en Cañas, protocolos de evacuación hospitalaria y evaluaciones de daños en curso. Las noticias económicas rutinarias, como el crecimiento de las exportaciones y el aumento del tránsito por el Canal, compensan en parte el desastre, pero el período está dominado por un gran desastre natural.
summary.fr: Une série de forts séismes (magnitude 7.5 mentionnée dans un titre) a frappé le Panama, faisant au moins trois morts. Des coupures de courant à Cañas, des protocoles d'évacuation hospitalière et des évaluations des dégâts sont en cours. Les nouvelles économiques courantes, comme la hausse des exportations et du trafic du canal, atténuent en partie la catastrophe, mais la période est dominée par une catastrophe naturelle majeure.
summary.de: Eine Reihe starker Erdbeben (in einer Schlagzeile mit bis zu Magnitude 7.5 angegeben) traf Panama, mindestens drei Menschen kamen ums Leben. Stromausfälle in Cañas, aktivierte Evakuierungsprotokolle in Krankenhäusern und Schadensbewertungen laufen. Routinemäßige Wirtschaftsnachrichten, etwa das Exportwachstum und steigende Kanaldurchfahrten, mildern die Katastrophe teilweise, doch der Zeitraum wird von einer großen Naturkatastrophe bestimmt.
summary.pt: Uma série de fortes terremotos (com magnitude de até 7.5 em uma manchete) atingiu o Panamá, com pelo menos três mortes, quedas de energia em Cañas, protocolos de evacuação de hospitais e avaliações de danos em andamento. Notícias econômicas de rotina, como o crescimento das exportações e o aumento das travessias do Canal, compensam em parte o desastre, mas o período é dominado por um grande desastre natural.
summary.it: Una serie di forti terremoti (segnalati fino a magnitudo 7,5 in un titolo) ha colpito Panama, con almeno tre vittime, interruzioni di corrente a Cañas, protocolli di evacuazione ospedaliera e valutazioni dei danni in corso. Notizie economiche di routine, come la crescita delle esportazioni e l'aumento dei transiti del Canale, compensano in parte il disastro, ma il periodo è dominato da un grave disastro naturale.
summary.ru: Серия сильных землетрясений (в одном заголовке сообщалось о магнитуде до 7,5) обрушилась на Панаму; по меньшей мере три человека погибли, в Каньясе отключено электроснабжение, действуют протоколы эвакуации больниц, идет оценка ущерба. Рутинные экономические новости, такие как рост экспорта и увеличение числа проходов через канал, отчасти смягчают эффект катастрофы, однако период определяется крупным природным бедствием.
summary.ar: سلسلة من الزلازل القوية (وردت في أحد العناوين بقوة تصل إلى 7.5 درجة) ضربت بنما، مما أسفر عن ثلاثة قتلى على الأقل، وانقطاع للتيار الكهربائي في كانياس، وتفعيل بروتوكولات إخلاء المستشفيات، وجارٍ تقييم الأضرار. وتخفف أخبار اقتصادية روتينية، كنمو الصادرات وزيادة عدد عبور القناة، من وقع الكارثة جزئياً، لكن الفترة يهيمن عليها كارثة طبيعية كبرى.
summary.fa: مجموعه‌ای از زمین‌لرزه‌های شدید (در یکی از تیترها تا بزرگای ۷٫۵ گزارش شده) پاناما را لرزاند و دست‌کم سه کشته برجای گذاشت. در کانیاس قطعی برق رخ داده، پروتکل‌های تخلیه بیمارستان‌ها فعال شده و ارزیابی خسارات ادامه دارد. اخبار اقتصادی معمول، مانند رشد صادرات و افزایش عبور از کانال، تا حدی از شدت این فاجعه می‌کاهد، اما این دوره عمدتاً تحت‌الشعاع یک بلای طبیعی بزرگ است.
summary.zh: 一系列强烈地震袭击了巴拿马（某则标题报道震级高达7.5级），至少造成三人死亡，卡尼亚斯出现停电，医院疏散程序已启动，损失评估正在进行。例行的经济新闻，如出口增长和运河通行量增加，在一定程度上抵消了灾情的影响，但这一时期主要由一场重大自然灾害主导。
summary.ja: パナマで一連の強い地震が発生し（ある見出しではマグニチュード7.5まで報じられている）、少なくとも3人が死亡した。カニャスでは停電が起き、病院では避難手順が発動され、被害評価が進行中である。輸出の増加や運河の通航量の増加といった通常の経済ニュースが災害を一部相殺しているが、この期間は大規模な自然災害が中心となっている。
summary.ko: 파나마에서 강한 지진이 연이어 발생했다(한 제목에서는 규모 7.5까지 보도됨). 최소 3명이 사망했으며, 카냐스에서는 정전이 발생했고 병원 대피 절차가 가동되었으며 피해 평가가 진행 중이다. 수출 증가와 운하 통항량 증가 같은 일상적인 경제 뉴스가 재난을 부분적으로 상쇄하고 있으나, 이 기간은 대규모 자연재해가 주를 이루고 있다.
summary.hi: पनामा में तेज़ भूकंपों की एक श्रृंखला आई (एक शीर्षक में तीव्रता 7.5 तक बताई गई), जिसमें कम से कम तीन लोगों की मौत हुई। कान्यास में बिजली गुल हुई, अस्पतालों में निकासी प्रोटोकॉल लागू किए गए और क्षति का आकलन जारी है। निर्यात वृद्धि और पनामा नहर से गुज़रने वाले जहाज़ों की संख्या में बढ़ोतरी जैसी नियमित आर्थिक खबरें आपदा के असर को कुछ हद तक संतुलित करती हैं, लेकिन यह अवधि एक बड़ी प्राकृतिक आपदा से प्रभावित है।
summary.el: Μια σειρά ισχυρών σεισμών (σε έναν τίτλο αναφέρεται μέγεθος έως 7.5) έπληξε την Παναμά, με τουλάχιστον τρεις νεκρούς, διακοπές ρεύματος στο Cañas, ενεργοποιημένα πρωτόκολλα εκκένωσης νοσοκομείων και εκτιμήσεις ζημιών σε εξέλιξη. Τα συνηθισμένα οικονομικά νέα, όπως η αύξηση των εξαγωγών και της κίνησης από τη Διώρυγα του Παναμά, αντισταθμίζουν εν μέρει την καταστροφή, ωστόσο η περίοδος κυριαρχείται από μια μεγάλη φυσική καταστροφή.

en: Series of strong earthquakes with at least three reported deaths
Power outages in Cañas and hospital evacuation protocols activated
Government assessing earthquake damage; Metro briefly suspended then resumed
tr: Üç ölüm bildirilen bir dizi güçlü deprem
Cañas'ta elektrik kesintileri ve hastane tahliye protokollerinin devreye alınması
Hükümet deprem hasarını değerlendiriyor; Metro kısa süreliğine durduruldu, ardından yeniden işletmeye açıldı
es: Serie de fuertes terremotos con al menos tres muertes reportadas
Cortes de electricidad en Cañas y activación de protocolos de evacuación hospitalaria
El gobierno evalúa los daños del terremoto; el Metro fue suspendido brevemente y luego reanudó el servicio
fr: Série de forts séismes ayant fait au moins trois morts
Coupures de courant à Cañas et activation des protocoles d'évacuation hospitalière
Le gouvernement évalue les dégâts du séisme ; le métro a été brièvement suspendu puis a repris
de: Serie starker Erdbeben mit mindestens drei gemeldeten Todesopfern
Stromausfälle in Cañas und aktivierte Evakuierungsprotokolle in Krankenhäusern
Regierung bewertet Erdbebenschäden; Metro kurzzeitig eingestellt, dann wieder in Betrieb
pt: Série de fortes terremotos com pelo menos três mortes registradas
Quedas de energia em Cañas e protocolos de evacuação de hospitais ativados
Governo avalia os danos do terremoto; o Metrô foi suspenso brevemente e depois retomado
it: Serie di forti terremoti con almeno tre vittime segnalate
Interruzioni di corrente a Cañas e attivazione dei protocolli di evacuazione ospedaliera
Il governo valuta i danni del terremoto; la Metro è stata sospesa brevemente e poi ripresa
ru: Серия сильных землетрясений, по меньшей мере три погибших
Отключения электроэнергии в Каньясе и активация протоколов эвакуации больниц
Правительство оценивает ущерб от землетрясения; метро ненадолго приостановлено, затем возобновлено
ar: سلسلة زلازل قوية مع ما لا يقل عن ثلاثة قتلى مُبلَّغ عنهم
انقطاع الكهرباء في كانياس وتفعيل بروتوكولات إخلاء المستشفيات
الحكومة تقيّم أضرار الزلزال؛ توقف مترو الأنفاق لفترة وجيزة ثم استأنف عمله
fa: مجموعه زمین‌لرزه‌های شدید با دست‌کم سه کشته گزارش‌شده
قطعی برق در کانیاس و فعال‌سازی پروتکل‌های تخلیه بیمارستان‌ها
دولت در حال ارزیابی خسارات زمین‌لرزه است؛ مترو به‌طور موقت متوقف و سپس دوباره راه‌اندازی شد
zh: 一系列强烈地震，已报告至少三人死亡
卡尼亚斯停电，医院疏散程序已启动
政府正在评估地震损失；地铁曾短暂暂停运营，随后恢复
ja: 少なくとも3人の死亡が報告された一連の強い地震
カニャスでの停電と病院の避難手順の発動
政府が地震被害を評価中。メトロは一時運転を停止した後、再開
ko: 최소 3명의 사망이 보고된 강한 지진의 연속
카냐스의 정전과 병원 대피 절차 가동
정부가 지진 피해를 평가 중이며, 메트로는 잠시 운행이 중단된 후 재개됨
hi: कम से कम तीन मौतों के साथ तेज़ भूकंपों की श्रृंखला
कान्यास में बिजली कटौती और अस्पताल निकासी प्रोटोकॉल सक्रिय
सरकार भूकंप से हुई क्षति का आकलन कर रही है; मेट्रो कुछ समय के लिए बंद होकर फिर से चालू हुई
el: Σειρά ισχυρών σεισμών με τουλάχιστον τρεις αναφερόμενους νεκρούς
Διακοπές ρεύματος στο Cañas και ενεργοποίηση πρωτοκόλλων εκκένωσης νοσοκομείων
Η κυβέρνηση εκτιμά τις ζημιές από τον σεισμό· το Μετρό διακόπηκε για λίγο και στη συνέχεια επαναλειτούργησε

summary.en: In Suriname, there is no notable crisis in the past 24 hours; the news consists mostly of routine local events such as traffic accidents, fires, robberies, and an eviction ultimatum to illegal settlers in the Masonia area. In contrast, news of Sunny Point gaining access to clean drinking water, an investment of 600,000 euros in emergency care training, relations with Vietnam and Spain, and mining investment is mildly positive. The overall picture reflects an ordinary period.

en: Clean drinking water reaching Sunny Point after years and an investment of 600,000 euros in emergency care training
Police ultimatum to illegal settlers in the Masonia area (until October 23)
Traffic accidents, drownings, armed incidents, fires and robberies (routine crime and safety news)
Gold mining investments and diplomatic/economic relations with Vietnam and Spain
Reports of deforestation in Kabo and concerns about illegal gold mining

summary.en: A mostly routine news day in Suriname, with cultural awards, health-worker training, and investment and jobs news offsetting a shooting-linked death, a trafficking case, and a gold export discrepancy. GDELT tone is less negative than the world average, so the score sits slightly above the baseline.

en: Staatsolie and Zijin seeking 3,600 workers for gold project expansion
Gold export figures show a 12.6-ton discrepancy, a governance concern
Body with gunshot wound found in Lawa area, possibly linked to robbery

summary.en: The period is largely routine: an anti-corruption taskforce was set up, OAS institutional support was discussed, and a toxic chemical was removed after a court ruling. Offsetting this, bushfires near Paramaribo, a recurring fuel-depot fire, pesticide breaches and nurse departures weigh on the picture, and GDELT tone is only slightly below average.

en: Anti-corruption taskforce established and OAS institutional support talks
Toxic methylbromide removed at Warsha after court ruling
Bushfire smoke reaching Nieuw-Amsterdam; fuel-depot fire at Apoera

summary.en: Mostly routine news: a first-of-its-kind Supreme Court ruling and a new anti-corruption taskforce point to institutional activity, offset by a shooting, armed robberies and a malaria resurgence warning. GDELT tone is somewhat more negative than the world average, but the overall picture is an ordinary day with slight positive lean.

en: Court of Justice rules in a first in 157 years
New taskforce launched to tackle corruption
Malaria re-emergence warning from public health authorities

summary.en: The period is routine: a sunken cargo boat with no casualties, a fatal shooting with an arrest, and local power-supply protests are offset by the Court of Justice being strengthened with fifteen judges and cultural successes. Health warnings on polio and malaria add mild concern, but nothing indicates a crisis.

en: Court of Justice strengthened with fifteen additional judges
Residents threaten road blockade over 24-hour electricity demand
PAHO warning on polio risk from low vaccination rates

summary.en: The period mixes routine news with several negative items: a fatal shooting and a prison uprising, deaths in separate incidents, and a stalled Constitutional Court that a commentator says weakens the rule of law. Positive items include youth sport progress, community health and cultural initiatives, and business interest in the oil and gas sector, and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average, so the score sits slightly below an ordinary day.

en: Constitutional Court not reactivated, rule of law described as weakened
Fatal shooting suspect taken from angry crowd; prison uprising
Pending court ruling in the TAS dispute

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: a hospital renovation and children's ward project, Inter-Guyanese Games results, and crime and traffic reports. Negative signals include ongoing power loadshedding, a governance dispute at TAS described as an institutional crisis, and a court-ordered eviction, which keep the score slightly below a typical day.

en: TAS governance dispute and court-ordered eviction of its leader
Continued electricity loadshedding until end of November
Calls to strengthen the Constitutional Court

summary.en: The period was largely routine: a tentative accord between government and teachers' unions, new appointments to the independent electoral bureau, and a central bank view that the financial sector is resilient. Offsetting concerns included the removal of 60 Mennonites and prepared deportation, and mining-related pollution probes.

en: Interim agreement between government and teachers' unions
Appointment of new Independent Electoral Bureau leadership
Removal of 60 Mennonites from Mazonia pending deportation

summary.en: The period mixes routine crime reports (an armed robbery, an unexplained shooting death, a fire in Ornamibo) with positive diplomatic and social items, including US$3 million in extra US security funding and a German parliamentary delegation. Overall this reads as an ordinary day with a mild negative lean.

en: US$3 million extra US security aid for Suriname
Armed robbery and unexplained shooting death reported
Ornamibo fire causing serious local hardship

summary.en: The period is dominated by the forced-expulsion case of 63 Mennonites, with court challenges rejected and a charter flight being prepared, plus an unregulated gold-rush influx in Matawai. Offsetting positives include US security aid, record humanitarian containers and drill results, while GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Court rejections clear way for expulsion of 63 Mennonites
Gold-rush influx in Matawai reaching about 8,000 people
US provides USD 3 million for crime-fighting cooperation

summary.en: The period is a mix of routine news: an 80 MW power shortage, a delayed criminal procedure law, and food-safety and water-quality concerns, offset by a forecast of strong growth and a planned gold-sector regulation. Reports of planned expulsions of Mennonite families and a missing service weapon add to the concern, so the score sits slightly below an ordinary day.

en: Power capacity shortfall of 80 MW and push for solar
Deportation of Mennonite families moving closer
Criminal procedure law reform postponed again

summary.en: A mixed day in Suriname: the expulsion of Mennonites and a pending court challenge, plus SLM budget cuts and a violent robbery weigh negatively. Offsetting this are a French-backed push to lift Suriname from the aviation blacklist, investment-facilitation plans, and a growth forecast, and GDELT tone is slightly less negative than the world average.
summary.tr: Surinam'da karışık bir gün: Menonitlerin sınır dışı edilmesi ve bekleyen bir mahkeme itirazı, ayrıca SLM bütçe kesintileri ve şiddetli bir soygun olumsuz etki yaratıyor. Bunu dengeleyen unsurlar ise Fransa destekli Surinam'ın havacılık kara listesinden çıkarılması çabası, yatırım kolaylaştırma planları ve bir büyüme tahmini; GDELT tonu ise dünya ortalamasından biraz daha az olumsuz.
summary.es: Un día mixto en Surinam: la expulsión de menonitas y una impugnación judicial pendiente, además de los recortes presupuestarios del SLM y un robo violento, pesan negativamente. Compensan en parte el impulso respaldado por Francia para sacar a Surinam de la lista negra de aviación, los planes de facilitación de inversiones y una previsión de crecimiento, y el tono de GDELT es ligeramente menos negativo que la media mundial.
summary.fr: Journée contrastée au Suriname : l'expulsion de mennonites et un recours judiciaire en attente, ainsi que les coupes budgétaires du SLM et un vol avec violence, pèsent négativement. Ces éléments sont compensés par l'initiative soutenue par la France visant à retirer le Suriname de la liste noire de l'aviation, par des plans de facilitation des investissements et par une prévision de croissance ; le ton de GDELT est légèrement moins négatif que la moyenne mondiale.
summary.de: Ein gemischter Tag in Suriname: Die Ausweisung von Mennoniten mit einer anhängigen Gerichtsklage sowie drastische Haushaltskürzungen beim SLM und ein gewaltsamer Raubüberfall wirken negativ. Dem gegenüber stehen ein von Frankreich unterstützter Vorstoß, Suriname von der Luftfahrt-Schwarzliste zu nehmen, Pläne zur Investitionserleichterung und eine Wachstumsprognose; der GDELT-Ton ist etwas weniger negativ als der weltweite Durchschnitt.
summary.pt: Um dia misto no Suriname: a expulsão de menonitas e uma contestação judicial pendente, além dos cortes orçamentários do SLM e um assalto violento, pesam negativamente. Compensam a iniciativa apoiada pela França para retirar o Suriname da lista negra da aviação, os planos de facilitação de investimentos e uma previsão de crescimento; o tom do GDELT é ligeiramente menos negativo do que a média mundial.
summary.it: Una giornata mista in Suriname: l'espulsione dei mennoniti e un ricorso giudiziario in attesa, insieme ai tagli al bilancio di SLM e a una rapina violenta, pesano negativamente. Compensano questi fattori una spinta sostenuta dalla Francia per far uscire il Suriname dalla lista nera dell'aviazione, piani per la facilitazione degli investimenti e una previsione di crescita, mentre il tono di GDELT è leggermente meno negativo della media mondiale.
summary.ru: Неоднозначный день в Суринаме: высылка меннонитов и ожидающее рассмотрение судебное оспаривание, а также сокращение бюджета SLM и вооружённое ограбление оказывают негативное влияние. Этот эффект частично компенсируют поддерживаемая Францией инициатива по исключению Суринама из чёрного списка авиации, планы по содействию инвестициям и прогноз роста; тон GDELT немного менее негативен, чем в среднем по миру.
summary.ar: يوم متباين في سورينام: يؤثر سلباً ترحيل الميennonites والطعن القضائي المعلق، إضافةً إلى تخفيضات ميزانية SLM وعملية سطو عنيفة. ويقابل ذلك دفعٌ تدعمه فرنسا لرفع اسم سورينام من القائمة السوداء للطيران، وخطط لتيسير الاستثمار، وتوقعات بالنمو، كما أن نبرة GDELT أقل سلبية بقليل من المتوسط العالمي.
summary.fa: روزی آمیخته در سورینام: اخراج منونیت‌ها و یک اعتراض قضایی در انتظار رسیدگی، همراه با کاهش بودجه SLM و یک سرقت خشونت‌آمیز، تأثیر منفی دارند. در مقابل، تلاشی با حمایت فرانسه برای خروج سورینام از فهرست سیاه هوانوردی، برنامه‌های تسهیل سرمایه‌گذاری و پیش‌بینی رشد قرار دارد و لحن GDELT اندکی کمتر منفی از میانگین جهانی است.
summary.zh: 苏里南当天情况喜忧参半：门诺派教徒被驱逐及尚待审理的司法诉讼、SLM的预算削减以及一起暴力抢劫案产生负面影响。与此相抵的是，法国支持苏里南移出航空黑名单的努力、促进投资的计划以及增长预测；GDELT的语气比全球平均水平略微不那么负面。
summary.ja: スリナムにとって入り混じった一日となった。メノナイトの国外追放と係争中の法的異議申し立て、SLMの予算削減、暴力的な強盗事件は否定的な要素である。一方で、フランスの支援によるスリナムの航空ブラックリスト解除の働きかけ、投資円滑化計画、成長見通しがこれを相殺している。GDELTのトーンは世界平均よりわずかに否定的でない水準である。
summary.ko: 수리남에서는 엇갈린 하루였다. 메노나이트 추방과 계류 중인 법적 이의 제기, SLM의 예산 삭감, 폭력적인 강도 사건이 부정적 요인으로 작용했다. 반면 프랑스의 지원을 받아 수리남을 항공 블랙리스트에서 제외하려는 움직임, 투자 촉진 계획, 성장 전망은 이를 상쇄하고 있다. GDELT 어조는 세계 평균보다 약간 덜 부정적이다.
summary.hi: सूरीनाम में मिला-जुला दिन रहा। मेनोनाइट समुदाय के निष्कासन और लंबित अदालती चुनौती, साथ ही SLM में बजट कटौती और हिंसक लूटपाट का असर नकारात्मक रहा। इसके विपरीत, फ़्रांस के समर्थन से सूरीनाम को विमानन ब्लैकलिस्ट से बाहर निकालने के प्रयास, निवेश सुविधा योजनाएँ और विकास पूर्वानुमान सकारात्मक रहे। GDELT का स्वर वैश्विक औसत से थोड़ा कम नकारात्मक है।
summary.el: Μια μικτή ημέρα στο Σουρινάμ: η απέλαση των Μενονιτών και η εκκρεμής δικαστική προσφυγή, καθώς και οι περικοπές του προϋπολογισμού της SLM και μια βίαιη ληστεία, επιδρούν αρνητικά. Αντισταθμιστικά λειτουργούν η προσπάθεια με τη στήριξη της Γαλλίας να αφαιρεθεί το Σουρινάμ από τη μαύρη λίστα της αεροπορίας, τα σχέδια διευκόλυνσης επενδύσεων και η πρόβλεψη ανάπτυξης. Ο τόνος του GDELT είναι ελαφρώς λιγότερο αρνητικός από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο.

en: Mennonite expulsion proceeding with pending court challenge
France helping Suriname exit aviation blacklist
Drastic new budget cuts announced at SLM
tr: Menonitlerin sınır dışı edilmesi sürüyor; mahkeme itirazı beklemede
Fransa, Surinam'ın havacılık kara listesinden çıkmasına yardımcı oluyor
SLM'de radikal yeni bütçe kesintileri açıklandı
es: Expulsión de menonitas en curso con una impugnación judicial pendiente
Francia ayuda a Surinam a salir de la lista negra de aviación
El SLM anuncia drásticos nuevos recortes presupuestarios
fr: Expulsion des mennonites en cours, avec un recours judiciaire en attente
La France aide le Suriname à sortir de la liste noire de l'aviation
Le SLM annonce de nouvelles coupes budgétaires drastiques
de: Ausweisung der Mennoniten läuft, Gerichtsverfahren anhängig
Frankreich hilft Suriname beim Austritt von der Luftfahrt-Schwarzliste
SLM kündigt drastische neue Haushaltskürzungen an
pt: Expulsão de menonitas em andamento, com contestação judicial pendente
França ajuda o Suriname a sair da lista negra da aviação

it: Espulsione dei mennoniti in corso, con un ricorso giudiziario pendente
La Francia aiuta il Suriname a uscire dalla lista nera dell'aviazione
Annunciati drastici nuovi tagli al bilancio di SLM
ru: Высылка меннонитов продолжается, судебное оспаривание ожидает рассмотрения
Франция помогает Суринаму выйти из чёрного списка авиации
В SLM объявлены масштабные новые сокращения бюджета
ar: استمرار ترحيل الميennonites مع وجود طعن قضائي معلق
فرنسا تساعد سورينام على الخروج من القائمة السوداء للطيران
الإعلان عن تخفيضات حادة جديدة في ميزانية SLM

کمک فرانسه به خروج سورینام از فهرست سیاه هوانوردی
اعلام کاهش شدید بودجه جدید در SLM

法国协助苏里南移出航空黑名单
SLM宣布大幅削减新预算

フランスがスリナムの航空ブラックリスト解除を支援
SLMで大幅な新たな予算削減が発表

프랑스가 수리남의 항공 블랙리스트 해제를 지원

फ़्रांस सूरीनाम को विमानन ब्लैकलिस्ट से बाहर निकलने में मदद कर रहा है

summary.en: The period is largely routine: news on aviation safety and trade cooperation with Canada, tourism and investment is positive. On the other hand, deaths in security operations, the killing of a police officer, power outages and strikes over high prices, along with mass deportation procedures, form a counterbalancing negative load. There is no clear crisis; positive and negative elements balance each other.

en: Aviation safety and trade cooperation agreement with Canada
Death of 11 suspects in the operation in Santiago and the toughness of the security plan
Power outages in San Francisco de Macorís and surrounding areas, and a strike against prices
Deportation of about 3,000 Haitians in two days
Tourism and investment news (Accor, Breeze, Hyatt)

summary.en: The period is largely routine: investment and tourism announcements (Accor, Four Seasons), a labour inspection of Chinese-owned stores, and ongoing security operations. A strike in San Francisco de Macorís with reported detentions is the main tension, and overall tone is less negative than the world average.

en: Strike in San Francisco de Macorís intensifies with reported detentions
Accor announces hotel projects with over 5,000 rooms
Labour ministry inspects 24 Chinese-owned stores over violations

summary.en: A mostly routine day: heavy-rain alerts and flooding in Santiago and the north, plus a killing in Nagua and a police chief accused over deaths. Partly offset by the resumption of mango exports to the US, areas returning to normal after earlier disruption, and ordinary investment and culture news. GDELT tone is more negative than the world average, but the headlines show no crisis.

en: Heavy rains and flood alerts across many provinces
Police chief accused over deaths; Nagua killing investigation
Mango exports to US set to resume

summary.en: The period is dominated by a rain event (vaguada) that affected about 1,793 people and 358 homes in Puerto Plata, with alerts in 22 to 23 provinces, a moderate weather disaster. Otherwise the news is routine, with positive investment and aviation items and a Haiti border security concern, and GDELT tone is slightly less negative than the world average.

en: Vaguada rains affecting about 1,793 people and 358 homes in Puerto Plata
COE alerts across 22 to 23 provinces for flood risk
Investment promotion and airline growth headlines (BCRD award, Arajet Mexico)

summary.en: The period was dominated by heavy-rain alerts that affected about 2,360 people and 590 homes, though authorities later scaled alerts back to two provinces. Otherwise the news was routine: migration enforcement, border troop deployments, tourism and agriculture items, and a relatively mild news tone.

en: Rain flooding affected 2,360 people and 590 homes
COE reduced emergency alerts to two provinces and the Distrito Nacional
Border troop deployment above 10,000 amid Haiti situation

summary.en: A largely routine day in the Dominican Republic, with the most notable development being an official report of a 17% drop in the cumulative homicide rate versus 2025. Smaller items included a rice-farmer march, border reinforcement along Haiti, and a foreign report on Dominican men allegedly recruited into the Russian army, against a mildly negative news tone.

en: Official report: homicide rate down 17% versus 2025
Routine DNCD drug arrests in Distrito Nacional
Rice producers march in Nagua over government protection

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: weather alerts from a trough, social-program and infrastructure announcements, and sports and trade news. It is weighed down by a border reinforcement against the Haiti crisis, a brutal murder case, and a fatal police confrontation, and the news tone is somewhat more negative than the world average.

en: Deployment of two battalions and artillery to the Haiti border
Weather alerts for 14-16 provinces from a trough
Brutal decapitation murder of mother and daughter

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: rain-related yellow alerts and flooding affected a few hundred people and damaged about 100 homes, with a border reinforcement against Haiti and a large contraband seizure. Positive notes include the exit from the FAO Hunger Map and the opening of the World Police Games, which offset the weather impacts.

en: Yellow weather alerts and flooding affecting 412 people
Exit from FAO Hunger Map announced
World Police Games inaugurated with 32 countries

summary.en: The period is dominated by heavy rains and weather alerts across many provinces, with a foreign report of flood deaths and damaged homes. Offsetting this are positive development stories, including FAO recognition after the country left the Hunger Map, new cold-storage investment, and vocational training integration.

en: Rain alerts in up to 18 provinces; flood risk in vulnerable zones
Reported flood deaths and destroyed homes in DR and Haiti
FAO recognition for exiting the Hunger Map

summary.en: Heavy rains and flooding displaced about 2,670 people, closed highways and suspended classes, and prompted government aid operations. Offsetting this, the country exited the FAO Hunger Map and reported US$4.5 billion in investment, with routine arms seizures and parliamentary cooperation deals.

en: Flooding displaces 2,670 people and closes Autopista del Nordeste
FAO hails Dominican exit from Hunger Map
Foreign investment reaches US$4.5 billion

summary.en: A mostly routine day with moderate rain-related flooding affecting about 2,600 people, met with food aid and alerts, alongside positive news of a first-ever World Baseball Classic-style U18 qualification and new trade ties with Portugal. GDELT tone is slightly more negative than the world average, which keeps the score near neutral.

en: Rains isolate 51 communities and affect over 2,600 people
Historic first qualification for U18 Baseball World Cup
Food aid deployed in flood-affected provinces

summary.en: The period is largely routine: weather alerts, tourism and investment announcements, and public works. Negative items include a US embassy warning on drugging and robbery of travellers, a prison escape, and debate over security plans, which offset positive items such as US praise as a counter-cartel ally and a new cruise port opening.

en: US embassy warnings on drugging and robbery of tourists
US praise of Dominican Republic as anti-cartel ally
New cruise port opening and tourism investment announcements

summary.en: A routine day in the Dominican Republic, dominated by government school and training-centre inaugurations and a central bank decision to hold rates. Migration enforcement and a US crime advisory are mild negatives, and the GDELT tone is slightly positive.
summary.ja: ドミニカ共和国の日常的な一日で、政府による学校およびInfotep職業訓練センターの開所式と、中央銀行による政策金利据え置きの決定が中心となった。移民取り締まりと米国の犯罪注意勧告は軽度のマイナス要因であり、GDELTのトーンはわずかにプラスであった。
summary.ko: 도미니카 공화국의 평범한 하루로, 정부의 학교 및 직업훈련센터 개소식과 중앙은행의 금리 동결 결정이 주요 뉴스였다. 이민 단속과 미국의 범죄 주의보는 약한 부정적 요인이었으며, GDELT 어조는 약간 긍정적이었다.
summary.hi: डोमिनिकन गणराज्य में एक सामान्य दिन, जिसमें सरकारी स्कूलों और प्रशिक्षण केंद्र के उद्घाटन तथा केंद्रीय बैंक द्वारा ब्याज दरें यथावत रखने का निर्णय प्रमुख रहा। आव्रजन प्रवर्तन और अमेरिकी अपराध सलाह हल्के नकारात्मक कारक थे, जबकि GDELT स्वर थोड़ा सकारात्मक रहा।
summary.el: Μια συνηθισμένη μέρα στη Δομινικανή Δημοκρατία, με κύρια θέματα τα εγκαίνια σχολείων και κέντρου επαγγελματικής κατάρτισης από την κυβέρνηση και την απόφαση της κεντρικής τράπεζας να διατηρήσει τα επιτόκια. Οι επιβολές μεταναστευτικής πολιτικής και η αμερικανική συμβουλευτική για εγκληματικότητα αποτελούν ήπιους αρνητικούς παράγοντες, ενώ ο τόνος του GDELT είναι ελαφρώς θετικός.
summary.it: Una giornata ordinaria nella Repubblica Dominicana, dominata dalle inaugurazioni di scuole e centri di formazione da parte del governo e da una decisione della banca centrale di mantenere invariati i tassi. Le operazioni di contrasto all'immigrazione e un avviso di sicurezza degli Stati Uniti sulla criminalità costituiscono lievi elementi negativi, mentre il tono rilevato da GDELT è leggermente positivo.
summary.ru: Обычный день в Доминиканской Республике, в центре внимания которого открытие правительством школ и учебного центра Infotep, а также решение центрального банка сохранить процентную ставку. Операции по борьбе с нелегальной миграцией и рекомендация США о безопасности, связанная с преступностью, оказывают умеренно негативное влияние, тон GDELT слегка позитивный.
summary.ar: يوم اعتيادي في جمهورية الدومينيكان، تهيمن عليه افتتاحات حكومية لمدارس ومركز تدريب، وقرار من البنك المركزي بإبقاء أسعار الفائدة دون تغيير. وتمثل عمليات إنفاذ قوانين الهجرة وتحذير أمني أمريكي بشأن الجريمة عوامل سلبية خفيفة، بينما نغمة GDELT إيجابية قليلاً.
summary.fa: یک روز عادی در جمهوری دومینیکن که با افتتاح مدارس و مرکز آموزشی توسط دولت و تصمیم بانک مرکزی مبنی بر حفظ نرخ بهره غالب است. عملیات اجرای قوانین مهاجرت و هشدار امنیتی ایالات متحده درباره جرم‌وجنایت، عوامل منفی خفیفی هستند و لحن GDELT اندکی مثبت است.
summary.zh: 多米尼加共和国的一个平常日子，主要新闻是政府为学校和培训中心举行的落成仪式，以及中央银行决定维持利率不变。移民执法和美国的犯罪安全提示构成轻微负面因素，GDELT的语气略微偏正面。
summary.tr: Dominik Cumhuriyeti'nde sıradan bir gün; hükümet okul ve eğitim merkezi açılışları ile merkez bankasının politika faizini sabit tutma kararı öne çıkıyor. Göç denetimleri ve ABD'nin suç uyarısı hafif olumsuz etkiler, GDELT tonu ise hafif olumlu.
summary.es: Un día rutinario en República Dominicana, dominado por la inauguración de escuelas y centros de formación por parte del gobierno y por la decisión del banco central de mantener las tasas. Las operaciones de control migratorio y una alerta de seguridad de Estados Unidos por delincuencia son leves factores negativos, y el tono de GDELT es ligeramente positivo.
summary.fr: Une journée ordinaire en République dominicaine, marquée par l'inauguration d'écoles et d'un centre de formation par le gouvernement, ainsi que par la décision de la banque centrale de maintenir son taux directeur. Les opérations de contrôle migratoire et un avertissement de sécurité des États-Unis liés à la criminalité pèsent légèrement, tandis que le ton de GDELT est légèrement positif.
summary.de: Ein routinemäßiger Tag in der Dominikanischen Republik, geprägt von der Eröffnung staatlicher Schulen und eines Ausbildungszentrums sowie der Entscheidung der Zentralbank, den Leitzins unverändert zu lassen. Migrationskontrollen und eine Kriminalitätswarnung der USA wirken leicht negativ, der GDELT-Ton ist leicht positiv.
summary.pt: Um dia rotineiro na República Dominicana, marcado pela inauguração de escolas e de um centro de formação pelo governo e pela decisão do banco central de manter a taxa de juros. As operações de fiscalização migratória e um alerta de segurança dos EUA sobre criminalidade são fatores negativos leves, e o tom do GDELT é ligeiramente positivo.

en: Government inaugurates schools and Infotep training centre in San Pedro de Macorís
Central bank holds monetary policy rate amid international uncertainty
Large migration enforcement operations detain over 2,000 irregular foreigners
ja: 政府がサン・ペドロ・デ・マコリス州で学校およびInfotep職業訓練センターの開所式を実施
中央銀行は国際的な不確実性の中で政策金利を据え置き
大規模な移民取り締まり作戦で2,000人以上の不法滞在外国人を拘束
ko: 정부, 산페드로데마코리스에서 학교 및 Infotep 직업훈련센터 개소
중앙은행, 국제적 불확실성 속에서 기준금리 동결
대규모 이민 단속 작전으로 2,000명 이상의 불법 체류 외국인 구금
hi: सरकार ने सैन पेड्रो डे मैकोरिस में स्कूलों और Infotep प्रशिक्षण केंद्र का उद्घाटन किया
केंद्रीय बैंक ने अंतरराष्ट्रीय अनिश्चितता के बीच मौद्रिक नीति दर यथावत रखी
बड़े पैमाने पर आव्रजन प्रवर्तन अभियानों में 2,000 से अधिक अनियमित विदेशियों को हिरासत में लिया गया
el: Η κυβέρνηση εγκαινιάζει σχολεία και το κέντρο κατάρτισης Infotep στο San Pedro de Macorís
Η κεντρική τράπεζα διατηρεί το επιτόκιο νομισματικής πολιτικής ενόψει της διεθνούς αβεβαιότητας
Μεγάλες επιχειρήσεις επιβολής μεταναστευτικής νομοθεσίας κρατούν σε κράτηση πάνω από 2.000 παράνομους αλλοδαπούς
it: Il governo inaugura scuole e il centro di formazione Infotep a San Pedro de Macorís
La banca centrale mantiene invariato il tasso di politica monetaria in un contesto di incertezza internazionale

zh: 政府在圣佩德罗德马科里斯为学校和Infotep培训中心举行落成仪式

Geniş kapsamlı göç denetimi operasyonlarında 2.000'den fazla düzensiz yabancı gözaltına alındı
es: El gobierno inaugura escuelas y el centro de formación del Infotep en San Pedro de Macorís
El banco central mantiene la tasa de política monetaria en medio de la incertidumbre internacional
Grandes operaciones de control migratorio detienen a más de 2.000 extranjeros en situación irregular
fr: Le gouvernement inaugure des écoles et le centre de formation de l'Infotep à San Pedro de Macorís
La banque centrale maintient son taux directeur dans un contexte d'incertitude internationale
De vastes opérations de contrôle migratoire aboutissent à la détention de plus de 2 000 étrangers en situation irrégulière

Banco central mantém a taxa básica de juros em meio a incertezas internacionais
